news.headline: Homer was elevated for the Steelers' Week 2 loss to the Patriots, playing two offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps
news.detail: Homer was elevated for the Steelers' Week 2 loss to the Patriots, playing two offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in the game while logging two rushes for 16 yards.
